csharp_space_after_dot #

Space after '.'. Inert: the oracle returns the file unchanged at both values. skala_space_around_dot is the key that governs the gap, and it is Tier A. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified duplicate spelling. Confirmed with a named control on the same fixture. Flat in both engines at both values on a chain written s . Trim() . ToUpper(), while skala_space_around_dot on that same fixture is CONFORMANT with two distinct outputs. The C# formatter answers to skala_space_around_dot and not to this MS spelling.

Typetrue / false
Defaultfalse
Default known fromnothing beyond the export
TierD — recorded so the key is not reported unknown; nothing reads it yet
